description: This file contains test functions for verifying the correctness of the Swagger and Redoc HTML generation functions in a FastAPI project. It tests the inclusion of URLs and assets in the generated documentation HTML content.

methods.name: test_strings_in_generated_swagger()
methods.description: Verifies that default URLs for Swagger UI assets are included in the generated Swagger HTML.

methods.name: test_strings_in_custom_swagger()
methods.description: Checks that custom URLs for Swagger UI assets are correctly embedded in the generated Swagger HTML.

methods.name: test_strings_in_generated_redoc()
methods.description: Ensures default URLs for Redoc assets are present in the generated Redoc HTML.

methods.name: test_strings_in_custom_redoc()
methods.description: Verifies custom URLs for Redoc assets are included in the generated Redoc HTML.

methods.name: test_google_fonts_in_generated_redoc()
methods.description: Checks the inclusion and exclusion of Google Fonts link in the Redoc HTML based on configuration.
